summary: MCP server 4: phase 1a-pre, bridge core with ping, get_state, screenshot
author: pm
body:
Listener on a private io_context polled at the top of `CGame::on_update`, bound to `address_v4::loopback()` without reuse_address; framing, dispatch, deferred replies. Commands `ping`, `get_state`, `screenshot` (bare file name into `build/screenshots/`, refuses paths and `..`). About 5 files, ~700 lines (derived). Detail: plan phase 1a-pre, `design.md`, `commands.md`.

**Done when:** a raw TCP client gets ping, state and a screenshot from a running Debug client; nothing listens off loopback; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.
